title: Fractional Sobolev sufficiency for integrable holonomy amplitude

fractional_sufficiency.hypothesis: G is scalar or finite-dimensional vector valued and belongs to H^s(R) for some s>1/2, with ||G||_(H^s)^2=(1/(2pi))int(1+t^2)^s|widehat G(t)|^2dt.
fractional_sufficiency.threshold: The weight integral is finite exactly when s>1/2; this proves the theorem and the threshold of this Cauchy-Schwarz route.
fractional_sufficiency.advance: K1628's H1 condition is sufficient but not necessary for this argument; every H^s primitive with s>1/2 has integrable Fourier/holonomy amplitude.
fractional_sufficiency.scope_guard: The theorem does not assert endpoint H^(1/2) sufficiency, electric-field L1, nonlinear remainder control, or source ownership.
